Student Factions Clash at Hyderabad University Over Remark

Two student groups clashed at Hyderabad University, reportedly using sticks against each other. The dispute originated from a comment made about a female friend. The conflict escalated from a "Teej" celebration event and spread from the hostel to the university gate. The incident occurred at JNTU, which is also referred to as Hyderabad University in the coverage.
